    Prepare sample points along stream segments

    prep_stream_sample_points.Rd

    Create regularly distributed points within each discretized reach segment for web-based stream-depletion apportionment, spatial inspection, or water-level evaluation between segment model points.

    prep_stream_sample_points(stream_segments, sample_spacing)

    Arguments

    stream_segments

    A projected stream-segment sf object, normally returned by prep_stream_segments(). It must contain reach_id, reach_segment_id, and represented_length columns and one LINESTRING geometry per row.

    sample_spacing

    A scalar units object with length dimensions giving the maximum stream length represented by each sample point. Must be finite and positive.

    Value

    An sf point object with columns reach_id, reach_segment_id, sample_point_id, and sampled_length. Every reach segment receives at least one point. sampled_length retains the linear units of the analysis CRS.

    Details

    The number of points in each reach segment is its length divided by sample_spacing and rounded up. Points are placed at the along-line centers of equal-length sampling intervals. This avoids duplicated points at shared segment boundaries and assigns every point an explicit sampled_length.

    These points are distinct from the single model_point stored with each reach segment. model_point represents the segment in the model, while the finer sample points describe its geometry during web apportionment. This is the same sampling calculation used by prep_adf_stream_apportionment(). Sample points are also distinct from finite-line quadrature points.

    Generating points does not change the stream discretization or injection schedules. The constant-head condition is imposed only at model_point locations, so water-level changes at sample points need not be zero. To use sample points as observation wells, create an observation_id column from sample_point_id.

    Examples

    stream_segments <- prep_stream_segments(
  example_stream_reaches,
  reach_spacing = units::set_units(400, "m")
)
sample_points <- prep_stream_sample_points(
  stream_segments,
  sample_spacing = units::set_units(100, "m")
)
sample_points$observation_id <- sample_points$sample_point_id
